# Java AccountRecord overlay vectors

Generated offline with the artifacts recorded in provenance.json. Each case applies the builder calls of signal-cli v0.14.9's StorageSyncModels.localToRemoteRecord to the invented cached self storage_record (`cachedRecord`): the self profile key, then the ConfigurationStore values with their defaults (true for receipts, typing, sealed-sender indicators and link previews, false for an unlisted number, UNKNOWN for phone-number sharing; CONTACTS and NOBODY both become NOBODY). signal-cli's account loader is not run, so those calls are restated, but decoding, building and encoding use signal-service-java's own Wire AccountRecord. A null configuration value means the source has no SQL row. Binary fields use padded base64; regeneration must reproduce vectors.json byte for byte.
